items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: they suggested, we need a vibe player to play with Nina Simone, and they suggested that it be me.

ctx.x: How did you get into that one? Just from your association . . . .
Gee, I’m trying to remember. It could have been Harold Land or Ray Brown. But they suggested, we need a vibe player to play with Nina Simone, and they suggested that it be me.
How was Nina? We know she came be temperamental, but she’s an amazing artist.
